description: This PHP script appears to be a test or example file demonstrating integration with a Bugzilla issue tracker within the TestLink project. It includes configuration setup, instantiation of a bug tracking interface, and calls to methods for retrieving issue details and checking issue existence.

classes.name: bugzilladbInterface
classes.description: An interface class for interacting with Bugzilla bug tracker database, facilitating retrieval and verification of bug issues.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific bug issue given its bug ID.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug issue with the specified bug ID exists in the database.
